Except I shall put my Finger

Richard Crashaw (G.) (c. 1613–1649)

J
OHN
 
XX.
 25
.
T
HY
 impious finger, would, it then, reborrow
The nails, the spear, each circumstance of sorrow?
That on a living Christ thou mayst rely,
Cruel, would’st thou thy Christ recrucify?
